reuse.why: Extends the existing getBulkActionCategories selection that every month-wide action already uses and reuses the shared extractTagsFromText tag parser.

duplication.why: The #fixed rule is added once in the shared selection function; no logic is repeated.

placement.why: The rule lands in the single category-selection helper for month-wide actions in actions.ts, beside the other exclusions.

scope.why: Only the selection helper, its comment and focused tests change.

maintainability.why: All exclusions remain in one function; the JS post-filter is a reasonable consequence of reusing the tag parser.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending and the averages all take their categories from getBulkActionCategories.

one_place.where: getBulkActionCategories in budget/actions.ts, used by every month-wide action.
